The '''daughter''' of a [[Unidentified crime lord (bangle)|crime lord]] was due to be [[Marriage/Legends|married]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and [[Gender/Legends|her]] father commissioned a [[Unidentified priceless bangle|priceless bangle]] from a [[Unidentified jeweler|jeweler]] for the wedding. When a [[Unidentified jewel thief|jewel thief]] stole the bangle without knowing who it was for, an independent individual negotiated a deal where the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] bought the bangle for a fraction of the jeweler's price.<ref name="Too Hot to Handle" />
